name: Applejack

categories.label: Brown: honey before doubling
categories.labelVi: Nâu: mật ong trước nhân đôi
categories.hint: Count only this variety. Subtract 3 separately from each connected area, minimum 0, then add the honey from those areas. Enter honey BEFORE doubling, not the number of apples; doubled automatically.

categories.label: Profitable varieties
categories.hint: Automatically counts varieties whose final harvest yields at least 1 honey before doubling. Each variety counts once, even with multiple areas.

formula.expr: countTrue(cat_honeyBrown > 0, cat_honeyDarkGreen > 0, cat_honeyLightGreen > 0, cat_honeyRed > 0, cat_honeyPink > 0, cat_honeyOrange > 0, cat_honeyYellow > 0)

categories.label: Variety bonus
categories.hint: Automatically scores 4/5/6/7 profitable varieties as 4/11/21/35 honey; 0–3 varieties score 0. This bonus is not doubled.

categories.label: Blossoms on tree tiles
categories.hint: 1 honey per blossom on your tree tiles (last blossom scoring).

categories.label: Honey in personal supply
categories.hint: Add all honey you still hold.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players all win.

notes: family: set-collection (area harvest + variety bonus). Honey earned and spent during play is not itemised; only leftover honey counts. Solo/campaign mode (goal 65 honey, 80 for extra) and optional modules (individual orchards, apple tiles, additional tree tile) not modelled. Rulebook layout verified from page image of final scoring spread (p.8 of the rulebook).
